findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts:532-596 fail-open when required checks are omitted. For a registered production-gate-decision surface such as authority-receipt-ref, evaluateProofAdmissibility defaults checks to {} and only rejects required schema/shape/digest/signature/material/subject/producer validations when callers explicitly pass false or an unsupported string. A caller that omits checks entirely still matches the production-completion policy and reaches allowed=true plus productionDoneEligible=true at lines 595-596. This violates the fail-closed contract for proof-looking artifacts and is not covered by packages/main/src/tasks/proof-admissibility-smoke.ts, which only exercises the happy path with all valid checks present and unknown artifacts without a definition.
findings.resolvedReason: evaluateProofAdmissibility now requires schemaVersion plus required strict shape, semantic digest, signature/receipt, temporal/material, subject, and producer checks to be present and valid; omitted required checks add denial reasons. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts:532: evaluateProofAdmissibility fails open when required checks are omitted. For authority-receipt-ref + DONE + production-completion, an empty checks object (or no checks) skips schema/shape/digest/signature/subject/producer/material requirements because the code only adds reasons when optional fields are explicitly false or mismatched. Repro: node --input-type=module -e "import { evaluateProofAdmissibility } from './packages/main/dist/core/proof-admissibility.js'; console.log(evaluateProofAdmissibility({artifactKind:'authority-receipt-ref',consumer:'DONE',claim:'production-completion'}))" returns allowed=true and productionDoneEligible=true with reasons=[]. This violates the plan admissibleProof conjunction and productionDone boundary: production-gate-decision should only be productionDone eligible after current schema, strict shape, semantic digest, signature/receipt, subject, producer, and temporal/material bindings are affirmatively valid. Add negative smoke coverage for missing checks and fail closed with missing_required_field/clause_not_bound (or equivalent structured reasons).
findings.resolvedReason: Same fail-open path fixed by requiring affirmative required checks before production-completion can be allowed. The proof smoke now covers omitted checks for authority-receipt-ref with AUTHORITY_GATE_DECISION and production-completion. Verified with build and proof smoke.

findings.desc: Known production-gate-decision artifacts fail open when required proof checks are omitted. In packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts:536 the evaluator defaults checks to {}, and lines 552-580 only add reasons when optional check fields are explicitly invalid/false. Because allowed is computed as policy && reasons.length === 0 at lines 595-596, evaluateProofAdmissibility({artifactKind:"authority-receipt-ref", consumer:"AUTHORITY_GATE_DECISION", claim:"production-completion"}) returns allowed=true and productionDoneEligible=true with no schema, shape, digest, signature/receipt, subject, producer, or material binding evidence. The smoke tests cover explicit stale/unsupported values and unknown artifact kind at packages/main/src/tasks/proof-admissibility-smoke.ts:119-153, but they do not cover missing checks for a known strong surface. Repro: node --input-type=module -e "import { evaluateProofAdmissibility } from './packages/main/dist/core/proof-admissibility.js'; console.log(JSON.stringify(evaluateProofAdmissibility({artifactKind:'authority-receipt-ref',consumer:'AUTHORITY_GATE_DECISION',claim:'production-completion'}), null, 2));" shows allowed=true and productionDoneEligible=true. This violates the story requirement for unknown fail-closed behavior and leaves a negative-control gap for authority-receipt-ref vs production-gate-decision.
findings.resolvedReason: Added negative control for known authority-receipt-ref production gate decision with omitted checks; evaluator now returns allowed=false and productionDoneEligible=false with missing_required_field/signature_missing/unknown_producer reasons. Verified with build and proof smoke.

findings.desc: Decision-doc production-gate example is out of sync with the implemented registry/inventory. The current registry and inventory use artifactKind authority-receipt-ref for the sole production-gate-decision surface (docs/evidence/proof-surface-inventory.md:42, docs/evidence/proof-surface-inventory.json:52, packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts:250), but the recommended output snippet still shows artifactKind authority-gate-receipt-proof with scope production-gate-decision (docs/requirements/decisions/proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md:1140-1145). This can mislead future gate consumers about the canonical artifact kind even though the classifier itself is consistent.
findings.resolvedReason: Updated the recommended production gate example to artifactKind authority-receipt-ref and aligned the raw Authority receipt inventory/registry schema list so stale authority-gate-receipt-proof wording remains only in raw verifier context. Verified with process fact contract.

findings.desc: F-001 is not fully fixed: the evaluator still has fail-open paths for missing/invalid required admissibility dimensions. In packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts:526-533, requireCheck only treats undefined as missing and false as invalid; runtime null values for required boolean checks are accepted as satisfied. A production-completion evaluation for authority-receipt-ref with strictShapeValid:null or producerBoundaryTrusted:null returns allowed:true and productionDoneEligible:true. The evaluator also does not require contractVersion: packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts:572-574 only rejects a present mismatched version, so omitting contractVersion while all other checks are true also returns allowed:true/productionDoneEligible:true. Repro after npm --prefix packages/main run build: node --input-type=module importing packages/main/dist/core/proof-admissibility.js and evaluating authority-receipt-ref/AUTHORITY_GATE_DECISION/production-completion produced omittedContract {"allowed":true,"productionDoneEligible":true,"reasons":[]}, nullRequired {"allowed":true,"productionDoneEligible":true,"reasons":[]}, and nullProducer {"allowed":true,"productionDoneEligible":true,"reasons":[]}. This violates the admissibleProof contract in docs/requirements/decisions/proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md:77-90, where producerBoundaryTrusted, supportedSchemaVersion, strictShapeValid, semanticDigestValid, signature/binding, temporal/material binding, consumer, and scope must all be satisfied. The smoke test covers omitted checks as a whole, but not null required fields or missing contractVersion, so the hidden fail-open path remains.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed the proof admissibility evaluator so required boolean checks pass only when the runtime value is exactly true; null, false, string, number, and other non-true values now add invalid denial reasons. contractVersion is now mandatory and must equal PROOF_ADMISSIBILITY_CONTRACT_VERSION; omitted/null add missing_required_field and wrong versions add unsupported_contract_version. Added proof-admissibility smoke coverage for null required checks, non-true boolean values, missing/null/wrong contractVersion, and the happy path with exact true checks/current contract. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:proof-admissibility; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.
